title: bleavit.receipt.v1
description:
What the chain recorded about one finalized extrinsic (10 §13.1).

Export only, and deliberately NOT a copy of the transaction that produced it. There is no encoded call, no signature and no payload here — a receipt carrying call bytes teaches a tool to offer them back, and they would not have been rebuilt against current state (10 §13, third rule).

What makes a receipt checkable is the anchor: re-read the chain at that block and that extrinsic index.

binding.description: The chain binding (10 §13.1). Gated on the live chain by exact equality — a schema cannot check that, so a valid binding here is not an admitted one.

genesisHash.description: Genesis hash of the chain this document was prepared against.

specVersion.description: The runtime spec_version. A NEWER one than the client is refused; an older one is rebuilt.

contractVersion.description: INTEGRATION_CONTRACT_VERSION, as the producing client reported it.

blockNumber.description: The finalized block containing the extrinsic.

extrinsicIndex.description: Its index within that block, so a reader can find the exact one.

call.description: Pallet.Call, as a NAME. Never an index and never bytes — a name cannot be resubmitted.

success.description: A failed dispatch is still a finalized fact.

error.description: Pallet.ErrorName from the frozen 02 §6 set, when it failed.
